sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "words_fts" USING fts5(word_id UNINDEXED, headword, definition, example, notes, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "words" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "headword" TEXT NOT NULL, "headword_normalized" TEXT NOT NULL, "part_of_speech" TEXT NULL, "ipa_uk" TEXT NULL, "ipa_us" TEXT NULL, "definition" TEXT NULL, "example" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "source_attribution" TEXT NULL, "is_favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favourite" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER words_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON words BEGIN INSERT INTO words_fts (word_id, headword, definition, example, notes) VALUES (new.id, new.headword, coalesce(new.definition, ''), coalesce(new.example, ''), '');END

CREATE TRIGGER words_fts_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON words BEGIN UPDATE words_fts SET headword = new.headword, definition = coalesce(new.definition, ''), example = coalesce(new.example, '') WHERE word_id = new.id;END
CREATE TRIGGER words_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON words BEGIN DELETE FROM words_fts WHERE word_id = old.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "word_notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES words (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER notes_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON word_notes BEGIN UPDATE words_fts SET notes = coalesce((SELECT group_concat(body, ' ') FROM word_notes WHERE word_id = new.word_id), '') WHERE word_id = new.word_id;END

CREATE TRIGGER notes_fts_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON word_notes BEGIN UPDATE words_fts SET notes = coalesce((SELECT group_concat(body, ' ') FROM word_notes WHERE word_id = new.word_id), '') WHERE word_id = new.word_id;END

CREATE TRIGGER notes_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON word_notes BEGIN UPDATE words_fts SET notes = coalesce((SELECT group_concat(body, ' ') FROM word_notes WHERE word_id = old.word_id), '') WHERE word_id = old.word_id;END
CREATE INDEX idx_notes_word ON word_notes (word_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_words_normalized ON words (headword_normalized)
CREATE INDEX idx_words_updated ON words (updated_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ipa_highlights" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES words (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_grapheme" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_grapheme" INTEGER NOT NULL, "color_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (end_grapheme > start_grapheme), CHECK (start_grapheme >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "word_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "word_list_items" ("list_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES word_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES words (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("list_id", "word_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_cards" ("word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES words (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "box" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ease_factor" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5, "repetitions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_reviewed_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_result" TEXT NULL, "suspended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("suspended" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("word_id"), CHECK (box >= 0 AND box <= 6));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "game_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "config_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "total_rounds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "correct_rounds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "affects_scheduling" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("affects_scheduling" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_answers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES words (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "round_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "response_ms" INTEGER NULL, "answered_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "tts_locale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en-GB', "tts_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5, "tts_pitch" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "autoplay_on_open" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("autoplay_on_open" IN (0, 1)), "daily_goal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "reminder_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reminder_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "reminder_time_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "prompt_side" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'word_first', "lookup_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("lookup_enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));
CREATE INDEX idx_highlights_word ON ipa_highlights (word_id, target)
CREATE INDEX idx_cards_due ON study_cards (due_at, suspended)
